name: PhilSMS Messaging
description: Send individual and selected-member SMS via PhilSMS
author: SDGTech Team of Soli Deo Gloria Christian Church–Davao City

settings.label: PhilSMS API Key
settings.help: Enter your PhilSMS API key. Leave blank to keep the existing key.

settings.label: Sender ID
settings.help: Enter your registered PhilSMS Sender ID, such as SDG Connect.

settings.label: Enable Live SMS Sending
settings.help: Allow actual SMS sending only when the server administrator also sets PHILSMS_LIVE_SEND=1. Otherwise, messages remain in dry-run mode.
